events.name: spawn
events.description: It appears: placed ones at level start, spawned ones on creation. `other` is the spawner or launcher, if any.

events.name: death
events.description: It dies (a unit) or is knocked out (a building or the king). `other` is the killer (may be none). event.types / event.weapon: the killing hit's (see damaged).

events.name: damaged
events.description: It takes damage (not when modifiers reduce it to 0). `other` is who dealt it: the king, a unit, a tower or building, a projectile's shooter, or whoever left burning ground or hot oil there; none for scenery hazards and plain `damage` actions without a source. event.types is the hit's damage types (a list: melee, ranged, tower, king, splash, magic, fire, the damage action's own types, and the weapon's id); event.weapon is the weapon that dealt it ("vanilla:<weapon>"), or none.

params.name: min
params.description: Only damage of at least this much.

events.name: healed
events.description: It is healed.

events.name: hpBelow
events.description: Its hp crosses below a fraction (edge-triggered; re-arms when healed above). Only its own hp: no `of`.

events.name: attack
events.description: It attacks (any attack, vanilla ones included).

events.name: hit
events.description: Its attack, projectile or damage action damaged something. event.types / event.weapon as for damaged.

events.name: kill
events.description: Something it damaged died from that damage. event.types / event.weapon as for damaged.

events.name: every
events.description: Periodically, from spawn (or level start).

params.name: jitter
params.description: Each interval varies randomly by up to this share of seconds (0.2: ±20%).

params.name: phase
params.description: Seconds before the first firing (default: seconds).

params.name: during
params.description: Only at night, by day, or always.

events.name: after
events.description: Once, that long after spawn (or level start).

events.name: near
events.description: A matching entity comes within (or leaves) a range of it.

params.name: edge
params.description: Fire on entering, leaving, or both.

events.name: enter
events.description: (areas) An entity matching the area's watch filter enters. Same frame: an entity spawned into the area, an area laid under one, and one walking in (checked every frame) get it in that same frame, so a status applied on enter is on before the next frame's attacks. `inside` first fires one full tick after entering: pair it with enter for a status that holds while inside.

events.name: exit
events.description: (areas) An entity leaves.

events.name: inside
events.description: (areas) For each entity inside, after every full `tick` it has spent inside.

events.name: empty
events.description: (areas) The last watched entity left.

events.name: occupied
events.description: (areas) The first watched entity entered.

events.name: impact
events.description: (projectiles) It hit something or the ground. `other` is what it hit (none for ground).

events.name: expire
events.description: Its lifetime (or projectile range) ran out; it's destroyed after its rules run.

events.name: arrive
events.description: (movers, path followers, moveTo) It reached a point.

events.name: bump
events.description: A push (the push action or the game's knockback) was stopped short by something solid: a wall or building, a solid body, a cliff or the map's edge. `other` is what it hit when that's an entity (a building, a wall, a solid body), else none; event.pos is where it stopped.

events.name: end
events.description: (movers, path followers) It reached the end of its path (before then: destroy acts).

events.name: pickup
events.description: (pickups) Collected. `other` is the collector.

events.name: interact
events.description: (interactables) The king used it, after paying its cost. event.choice is the chosen id with choices.

events.name: signal
events.description: It receives a signal. event.name is the signal's name, event.value its number.

params.name: name
params.description: Only this signal (omit to hear every signal).

events.name: varChanged
events.description: One of its variables changes (a level var, on the level script).

events.name: statusStart
events.description: A status starts on it.

params.name: status
params.description: Only this status (required when watching one from outside a status).

events.name: statusEnd
events.description: A status ends (expiry or removal).

events.name: statusTick
events.description: Every `tick` seconds of a status (in a status's own rules: of that status).

events.name: linked
events.description: It was linked to a parent (`link`, a template's parts). `other` is the parent.

events.name: unlinked
events.description: It was unlinked from its parent (`unlink`, or the parent died with onParentDeath drop/stay). `other` is the old parent.

events.name: interactRefused
events.description: (interactables) The king tried to use it but was short of gold or a `pay` item. event.name lists what was short.

events.name: targetChanged
events.description: Its attack or move target changes.

events.name: built
events.description: (build slots, map or added) It's built: by the king, `palace.py build` or the `building` action.

events.name: upgraded
events.description: (build slots, map or added) It's upgraded (any way it's built).

events.name: repaired
events.description: (build slots) It's revived at dawn.

events.name: coinDrop
events.description: A coin drops from a death (subject is the coin; listen with `of`).

events.name: coinPickup
events.description: The king collects a coin (subject is the coin; listen with `of`).

events.name: lineSpawn
events.description: (spawn lines) It spawns an enemy (a wave or spawnGroup). `other` is the new enemy.

events.name: levelStart
events.description: The level has loaded (after the overlay, before day 1).

events.name: dusk
events.description: Night is falling (the game's OnDusk).

events.name: nightStart
events.description: The night's first enemies spawn.

events.name: dawn
events.description: The sun rises (after income is paid).

events.name: day
events.description: The day phase begins (after dawn's sunrise).

events.name: waveCleared
events.description: Spawning is done and no enemies are left.

events.name: goldChanged
events.description: The player's balance changes.

events.name: kingAction
events.description: The player presses one of the level's action keys (logic.kingActions).

events.name: levelEnd
events.description: Win or loss, before the end screen. event.result is 'win' or 'lose'.

actions.name: spawn
actions.description: Creates entities from a template (a unit or an entity), e.g. split a slime, summon skeletons.

params.name: entity
params.description: The template (a pack unit or entity, or "vanilla:<id>"); "=self.template" for a copy of itself.

params.name: team
params.description: Its team (default: the template's; owner = the spawner's).

params.name: elite
params.description: Whether spawned enemies are elite; inherit copies the spawner's.

params.name: facing
params.description: Yaw in degrees (default: the spawner's facing).

params.name: then
params.description: Run for each new entity, with `spawned` bound.

actions.name: launch
actions.description: Fires an entity as a projectile from the owner toward a target (it uses the template's projectile block).

params.name: entity
params.description: A template with a projectile block.

params.name: from
params.description: Start: an entity or position, or an [x, y, z] offset from self.

params.name: toward
params.description: The target: an entity (homing follows it) or a position.

params.name: onImpact
params.description: Extra actions on impact (the template's impact rules also run), with `spawned` = the projectile and `other` = what it hit.

params.name: then
params.description: Run once it's launched, with `spawned` bound.

actions.name: spawnGroup
actions.description: A wave-style group of enemies now; they count toward the night.

params.name: at
params.description: A position instead of a line.

actions.name: replace
actions.description: Swaps the entity for another template in place (morph, shapeshift).

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

actions.name: damage
actions.description: Deals exactly `amount`: the victim's damageTaken and a `weapon`'s modifiers apply, the source's own damageMult only with `scaled`.

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

params.name: source
params.description: Who is credited (fires their hit/kill events). Default self.

params.name: types
params.description: Damage-type labels (fire, ...) that status modifiers test.

params.name: splash
params.description: Counts as splash damage (the game's splash modifiers).

params.name: scaled
params.description: Scale it by the source's own damageMult (its statuses and setStat), as the source's own attacks are.

actions.name: heal
actions.description: Heals.

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

actions.name: kill
actions.description: Kills it (fires death).

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

actions.name: revive
actions.description: Revives a knocked-out building or a dead hittable entity.

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

params.name: hpPct
params.description: Hit points as a fraction of max.

actions.name: setHp
actions.description: Sets hit points without damaged/healed events (shared health pools).

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

actions.name: setStat
actions.description: Changes a stat, permanently or for a while. Give exactly one of value, add, mult.

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

params.name: for
params.description: Seconds, or "night"/"day" (until the next dawn/dusk); omit for permanent.

params.name: key
params.description: A timed change with the same key replaces the earlier one.

actions.name: applyStatus
actions.description: Applies a status (a timed, stacking modifier set).

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

params.name: source
params.description: Who applied it (`other` in its rules). Default self.

actions.name: removeStatus
actions.description: Removes a status (all stacks, or some).

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

actions.name: setWeapon
actions.description: Gives it another weapon (units, towers, the king): a weapon id, a copy of another entity's weapon, none, or its own back. A ranged weapon makes it shoot: its range follows the weapon.

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

params.name: weapon
params.description: "vanilla:<weapon>" (e.g. "=other.weapon"), an entity to copy ("=other": its weapon, range and keep distance), "none" (its attacks do nothing) or "base" (the weapon it started with).

params.name: range
params.description: Attack range in metres (default: the copied entity's, else the weapon's usual range).

params.name: for
params.description: Seconds, or "night"/"day"; then it gets back the weapon it had before. Omit to keep it.

actions.name: convert
actions.description: Switches team (a dead target is raised as a new entity of that team).

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

params.name: team
params.description: "player" | "enemy" | "neutral", or an expression such as self.team.

params.name: hpPct
params.description: Hit points as a fraction of max.

actions.name: teleport
actions.description: Moves it instantly. A building or the castle moves with its whole build slot (colliders, navmesh cut, add-ons) onto the ground at `at`; enemies repath to it, and the castle still loses the level when it falls.

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

actions.name: push
actions.description: A one-off shove (the game's knockback), on units (flyers included).

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

actions.name: drift
actions.description: A continuous velocity added to movement: a pull, a current, wind. Different keys add up; the same key replaces.

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

params.name: key
params.description: Replaces an earlier drift with the same key.

actions.name: moveTo
actions.description: Walks it to a point; fires arrive there.

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

actions.name: setMovement
actions.description: Changes its movement block (see Movement).

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

actions.name: setTargeting
actions.description: Changes who it attacks and walks toward.

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

actions.name: taunt
actions.description: Forces aggro onto an entity (the game's agro mechanism).

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

actions.name: command
actions.description: Orders player units as the king's own commands.

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

actions.name: link
actions.description: Links it to a parent as a part: it moves (and turns) with the parent every frame, may share its damage, and follows onParentDeath when the parent dies. Re-linking moves it to the new parent.

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

params.name: offset
params.description: Where it sits in the parent's frame: [x, y, z], x right, y up, z ahead (default: where it is now).

params.name: rotY
params.description: Its yaw relative to the parent's (default: as it is now).

params.name: follow
params.description: rigid: moves and turns with the parent every frame; position: moves, keeps its own yaw; none: a relation only (it moves on its own, e.g. movement follow).

params.name: onParentDeath
params.description: When the parent dies: die with it, drop (unlinked, set on the ground) or stay (unlinked, left where it is).

params.name: damageToParent
params.description: This much of every hit it takes is dealt to the parent too (2 = double: a weak point).

params.name: damageToGroup
params.description: This fraction of every hit is shared evenly by its whole linked group, itself included (1 = one shared pool).

params.name: damageKept
params.description: The fraction it takes itself, before the group share (0 = a pure proxy hitbox).

actions.name: unlink
actions.description: Unlinks it from its parent (or, with children, unlinks its parts).

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

params.name: release
params.description: drop: set it on the ground; stay: leave it where it is.

params.name: children
params.description: Unlink its parts instead of itself.

actions.name: signal
actions.description: Sends a named signal (optionally with a number) to entities or everyone.

params.name: name
params.description: The signal's name (a built-in input such as open, enable, destroy, or your own).

params.name: to
params.description: Who receives it: a selector, or "all" (every listener and the level script).

actions.name: setVar
actions.description: Sets a variable (an entity var on target, or a level var: target level, or a name with $).

params.name: target
params.description: Whose variable (default self; "level" for a level var).

actions.name: addVar
actions.description: Adds to a number variable.

params.name: target
params.description: Whose variable (default self; "level" for a level var).

actions.name: listAdd
actions.description: Appends to a list variable (max 256; oldest dropped).

actions.name: listRemove
actions.description: Removes the first equal item, or the item at an index.

actions.name: listClear
actions.description: Empties a list variable.

actions.name: addLabel
actions.description: Adds a label (filters test #label).

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

actions.name: removeLabel
actions.description: Removes a label.

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

actions.name: enableRule
actions.description: Turns a rule (by id) on.

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

actions.name: disableRule
actions.description: Turns a rule (by id) off.

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

actions.name: enable
actions.description: Switches the entity on: rules, components (solid, hittable) and visibility. On a spawn line, resumes spawning.

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

actions.name: disable
actions.description: Switches the entity off. On a spawn line, pauses its spawning.

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

actions.name: toggle
actions.description: Switches it on if off, off if on.

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

actions.name: wait
actions.description: The rest of this action list resumes later.

actions.name: if
actions.description: Runs then or else.

actions.name: repeat
actions.description: Runs actions several times (event.value = the iteration).

params.name: actions
params.description: The actions ("actions", since "do" names the action itself).

actions.name: forEach
actions.description: Runs actions for each member of a set, with `it` bound.

params.name: actions
params.description: The actions ("actions", since "do" names the action itself).

params.name: as
params.description: A name for the member, readable inside (and in nested actions that rebind `it`): "as": "tower" then `tower.hp`.

actions.name: choose
actions.description: Picks one weighted option at random.

actions.name: stop
actions.description: Ends this action list.

actions.name: gold
actions.description: Gives (or takes, negative) gold; floored at 0.

actions.name: dropCoins
actions.description: Drops real coins for the king to collect.

actions.name: building
actions.description: Acts on a build slot.

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

params.name: slot
params.description: The slot: any expression giving a building or slot entity (@name, it, $var, nearest('unbuilt and type:House')...), or a Studio key ("slot:Tower 3", "add:<id>", "castle"). Default: the target.

params.name: value
params.description: For setCost/setIncome: the amount; for demolish: gold refunded.

actions.name: waves
actions.description: Edits the night's waves.

params.name: night
params.description: Which night (default: the next; "current" edits the running night).

params.name: survivors
params.description: endNight: the enemies left vanish (remove) or stay on the map (stay).

actions.name: terrain
actions.description: Changes the ground during play: heights, paint, blocked cells, water, ice and the water level. Only the touched area is re-meshed and re-pathed.

params.name: angle
params.description: The rectangle's turn (degrees, 0 = length runs north).

params.name: in
params.description: Use an area's or a body's own shape instead (e.g. "@fault").

params.name: softness
params.description: 0..1: how far in from the edge the change fades (heights; default 0.3).

params.name: height
params.description: set: the ground's new height (world y).

params.name: level
params.description: waterLevel: the water's new surface (world y).

params.name: flood
params.description: waterLevel: which low ground fills: joined to the water (default), every cell under the level, or none.

params.name: over
params.description: Seconds to animate heights or the water level (the paths follow at the end).

actions.name: endLevel
actions.description: Ends the run.

actions.name: effect
actions.description: Plays a game effect.

actions.name: sound
actions.description: Plays a sound.

actions.name: message
actions.description: Shows a message at the top of the screen.

actions.name: floatText
actions.description: Floating text over a spot.

actions.name: setVisual
actions.description: Changes its look.

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

params.name: glow
params.description: Glow colour; true for the default glow, false for none, or a 0-1 strength.

actions.name: hud
actions.description: Changes a level HUD line (logic.hud).

actions.name: shake
actions.description: Shakes the camera.

actions.name: marker
actions.description: A screen-edge marker like the game's wave markers.

actions.name: lighting
actions.description: Changes the level's light: darken it (an eclipse by day, a pitch-black night), tint it, or make day look like night. Reverts at the level's end, after `for`, or with `reset`.

params.name: brightness
params.description: Multiplies the sun's light: 1 = as the game has it, 0.2 = an eclipse, 0 = black. Units stay readable.

params.name: color
params.description: Tints the sunlight, #rrggbb (#ff9060 = a red dusk).

params.name: phase
params.description: The base light from the level's colours: day, sunset or night whatever the time; auto follows the game's day and night.

params.name: fade
params.description: Seconds to blend into the new light.

params.name: for
params.description: Seconds (or "night"/"day": until the next dawn/dusk); then it fades back.

params.name: reset
params.description: Back to the game's own light (the other params are ignored).

actions.name: setLight
actions.description: Gives it a light that follows it (or changes or removes its `light`): a torch on the king, a lantern on a unit, a lighthouse beam. Works on anything: units, the king, buildings, props, projectiles.

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

params.name: intensity
params.description: How bright: 1 lights its range fully.

params.name: range
params.description: Radius it lights on the ground (m); a cone's length.

params.name: cone
params.description: A beam this many degrees wide along its facing (empty: all round).

params.name: aim
params.description: A cone's yaw relative to its facing (degrees).

params.name: on
params.description: Switches it on or off (keeps its settings).

params.name: for
params.description: Seconds (or "night"/"day"); then it goes back to how it was.

actions.name: turn
actions.description: Turns it to face a direction: aim a beam, a turret, a blade wall, a placed area (its shape, outline, surface and solid footprint turn with it). Units turn their model (they turn back when they walk).

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

params.name: facing
params.description: Yaw in degrees to face (0 = north, 90 = east).

params.name: by
params.description: Degrees to turn by (clockwise; negative = anticlockwise).

actions.name: setShape
actions.description: Changes an area's shape or size (its outline, fill, membership and surface follow), or a body's footprint (its solid cut and collider follow).

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

params.name: shape
params.description: The new kind (default: keep the kind it has).

params.name: angle
params.description: sector: how wide (degrees), centred on its facing.

params.name: part
params.description: What to reshape (default: its area, else its body).

params.name: for
params.description: Seconds (or "night"/"day"); then the old shape comes back.

actions.name: destroy
actions.description: Removes it.

params.name: target
params.description: Who it acts on: a selector (one entity or a set; each member in turn, with `it` bound). Default self.

functions.name: vec
functions.description: A position: vec(x, z) on the ground, or vec(x, y, z).

functions.name: nearest
functions.description: The nearest match within r metres (anywhere if omitted), or none. Anchored at self; e.nearest(...) anchors at e.

functions.name: farthest
functions.description: The farthest match within r metres (anywhere if omitted), or none. Anchored at self; e.farthest(...) anchors at e.

functions.name: weakest
functions.description: The match with the least hp within r metres (anywhere if omitted), or none. Anchored at self; e.weakest(...) anchors at e.

functions.name: strongest
functions.description: The match with the most hp within r metres (anywhere if omitted), or none. Anchored at self; e.strongest(...) anchors at e.

functions.name: random
functions.description: A random match within r metres (anywhere if omitted), or none. Anchored at self; e.random(...) anchors at e.

functions.name: all
functions.description: Every match within r metres (anywhere if omitted), nearest first (max 256).

functions.name: best
functions.description: The match with the highest score (an expression over `it`).

functions.name: count
functions.description: How many match within r metres (anywhere if omitted).

functions.name: pointNear
functions.description: A random walkable point within r metres of p.

functions.name: groundY
functions.description: Height of the walkable ground at p (terrain, the map's ground or a walkable deck).

functions.name: walkable
functions.description: Whether something can stand at p. who: 'small' (ground enemies, default), 'large', 'air', 'player', or a unit (its own graph and surfaces).

functions.name: ground
functions.description: The ground at p: 'grass', 'highGrass', 'lowGrass', 'earth', 'sand', 'road', 'rock', 'water', 'ice', 'blocked', 'deck' or 'none'.

functions.name: waterDepth
functions.description: Metres of water over the ground at p (0 when dry or frozen).

functions.name: sight
functions.description: Whether a straight line from a to b (1.5 m up) is clear of ground, cliffs, walls, buildings and solid props.

functions.name: raycast
functions.description: Where the line from a to b (1.5 m up) first hits ground, a cliff, wall, building or solid prop; none if clear.

functions.name: ahead
functions.description: d metres ahead of e (along its facing).

functions.name: toward
functions.description: d metres from a toward b.

functions.name: lerp
functions.description: a + (b - a) * t, for numbers or positions.

functions.name: spawnLine
functions.description: The centre of a spawn line by name.

functions.name: dir
functions.description: A unit vector at deg degrees (0 = north, 90 = east).

functions.name: angle
functions.description: Degrees from a to b (0 = north).

functions.name: dist
functions.description: Distance between two positions or entities; e.dist(x) from e.

functions.name: min
functions.description: The smallest.

functions.name: max
functions.description: The largest.

functions.name: abs
functions.description: abs(x).

functions.name: floor
functions.description: floor(x).

functions.name: ceil
functions.description: ceil(x).

functions.name: round
functions.description: round(x).

functions.name: sqrt
functions.description: sqrt(x).

functions.name: sin
functions.description: sin(x), x in degrees.

functions.name: cos
functions.description: cos(x), x in degrees.

functions.name: clamp
functions.description: x limited to lo..hi.

functions.name: pow
functions.description: x to the power y.

functions.name: rand
functions.description: rand(): 0..1; rand(a, b): a..b (the level's seeded random).

functions.name: randInt
functions.description: A whole number a..b inclusive.

functions.name: chance
functions.description: True with probability p.

functions.name: waveCount
functions.description: Enemies night n will spawn, optionally only templates matching a filter.

functions.name: waveUnits
functions.description: The templates night n spawns.

functions.name: lightAt
functions.description: How lit a point is, 0..1: daylight plus every light that reaches it (entity lights and the game's own, such as the castle's night fire). 0.5 and up counts as lit.

functions.name: strongestUnit
functions.description: Night n's strongest template (hp x damage).

functions.name: stacks
functions.description: Stacks of a status on it.

functions.name: is
functions.description: Whether it matches a filter.

functions.name: inside
functions.description: Whether it is inside an area.

functions.name: at
functions.description: The item at index i (0-based).

functions.name: has
functions.description: Whether the list or set contains x.

functions.name: sample
functions.description: k distinct items of the list or set picked at random (the level's seeded random), in random order; no k: all of them, shuffled. A set gives a set.

properties.name: alive
properties.description: Not dead (a knocked-out building is not alive).

properties.name: elite
properties.description: An elite enemy (the game's elite flag).

properties.name: facing
properties.description: Its yaw in degrees (0 = north, clockwise): where a unit's or the king's model faces (its walking direction, or its target while attacking), else its own rotation.

properties.name: template
properties.description: The template it was made from.

properties.name: level
properties.description: A build slot's level: 0 = empty (unbuilt), 1 = built, 2 = upgraded once...

properties.name: target
properties.description: Its current attack/move target (a tower: what its last volley aimed at, while that is alive).

properties.name: parent
properties.description: The entity it is linked to (link, parts), or none.

properties.name: children
properties.description: The entities linked to it (its parts).

properties.name: root
properties.description: The top of its link tree (itself when unlinked).

properties.name: group
properties.description: Its whole linked group: the root and every part below it, itself included.

properties.name: light
properties.description: How lit it is, 0..1: daylight plus the lights that reach it (lightAt(its position)).

properties.name: lit
properties.description: Whether it stands in the light (light >= 0.5): day, or near a light at night or in an eclipse.

properties.name: weapon
properties.description: Its current weapon's id ("vanilla:<weapon>"; the king's is his equipped weapon's auto attack), "none" when disarmed by setWeapon, or none.

properties.name: damageMult
properties.description: Multiplies damage dealt (mods may carry from/types/chance/when). (with modifiers)

properties.name: damageTaken
properties.description: Multiplies damage taken (mods may carry from/types/chance/when). (with modifiers)

properties.name: keepDistance
properties.description: Distance a ranged unit keeps. (with modifiers)

properties.name: aggroTime
properties.description: Seconds it chases after being hit. (with modifiers)

properties.name: income
properties.description: Gold a building pays at dawn. (with modifiers)

properties.name: timeScale
properties.description: Multiplies move speed, attack and rule timers, and its own projectiles. (with modifiers)

properties.name: name
properties.description: signal: the name; varChanged: the var; status events: the status.

properties.name: choice
properties.description: interact with choices: the chosen id.

properties.name: types
properties.description: damaged/hit/kill/death: the hit's damage types, e.g. event.types.has('fire').

properties.name: weapon
properties.description: damaged/hit/kill/death: the weapon that dealt the hit ("vanilla:<weapon>"), or none.

globals.name: night
globals.description: The current night (1-based), or the coming one by day.

globals.name: nights
globals.description: The level's total number of nights.

globals.name: nightProgress
globals.description: 0..1: the night's spawn schedule elapsed (1 once everything has spawned).

globals.name: income
globals.description: The gold the buildings paid at the last dawn (`income` stats applied), already counted when `dawn` rules run; the coins themselves land over the next seconds. A building knocked out during the night pays nothing that dawn (the game's rule), and the night's wave gold (enemies' coins) isn't income.

globals.name: daylight
globals.description: The level's own light, 0..1: 1 by day, about 0.34 at night, lower in an eclipse (`lighting`).

globals.name: waterLevel
globals.description: The terrain's water level (world y); 0 with no water. The `terrain` action's waterLevel op changes it.

globals.name: none
globals.description: No entity (what a selector gives when nothing matches, or a role the event doesn't have): `other != none`.

roles.name: self
roles.description: The rule's owner (the level in the level script).

roles.name: subject
roles.description: Who the event happened to (self for its own events; the other entity for `of` listeners).

roles.name: other
roles.description: The event's counterpart: killer, victim, attacker, entrant, collector, sender...

roles.name: it
roles.description: The current candidate: inside a filter's where(), best()'s score, forEach, or an action applied to a set.

roles.name: outer
roles.description: The `it` one scope out (the forEach member while a nested target, where() or best() rebinds `it`); none at the top.

roles.name: level
roles.description: The level itself (owner of level variables).

roles.name: event
roles.description: The event's fields: event.value, event.pos, event.name, event.choice, event.result.

stats.name: damageMult
stats.description: Multiplies damage dealt (mods may carry from/types/chance/when).

stats.name: damageTaken
stats.description: Multiplies damage taken (mods may carry from/types/chance/when).

stats.name: aggroTime
stats.description: Seconds it chases after being hit.

stats.name: income
stats.description: Gold a building pays at dawn.

stats.name: timeScale
stats.description: Multiplies move speed, attack and rule timers, and its own projectiles.

flags.name: noIncome
flags.description: A building pays nothing at dawn.

filterTerms.name: foe
filterTerms.description: The other side from self (for the level script: enemies).

filterTerms.name: alive
filterTerms.description: Alive (not dead, switched off or an unbuilt slot).

filterTerms.name: dead
filterTerms.description: Dead or knocked out. Naming it lets a selector see the dead.

filterTerms.name: disabled
filterTerms.description: Switched off (`disable`, or placed with active: false). Naming it lets a selector see switched-off things.

filterTerms.name: unbuilt
filterTerms.description: An empty build slot (level 0). Naming it lets a selector see empty slots, which it otherwise skips.

filterTerms.name: #label
filterTerms.description: Has a label (#"two words" for a label with spaces).

filterTerms.name: is:<template>
filterTerms.description: Made from a template (is:goblin, is:vanilla:Ogre, is:'vanilla:E Ogre').

filterTerms.name: in:@area
filterTerms.description: Inside an area (in:self inside this area). @<area template>: inside any area made from it (e.g. any of many spawned pools), checked live.

filterTerms.name: type:<Kind>
filterTerms.description: A building of that kind (type:Mill, type:"Defense Tower").

filterTerms.name: include:<what>
filterTerms.description: Matches everything, but lets a selector also see what it skips by default: include:dead, include:disabled, include:unbuilt, include:self (repeat it for more).

filterTerms.name: <Tag>
filterTerms.description: Any game tag (TagManager.ETag, case-sensitive): Tower, Flying, Wall, ...

paramTypes.number: a number, or an expression string ("night * 2")
paramTypes.int: a whole number, or an expression string
paramTypes.text: text with {expr} parts ("Souls {$souls}/10"); "=expr" makes the whole field an expression
paramTypes.position: an expression giving a position or an entity (self, other, @name, vec(x, z), pointNear(self, 3)), or [x, y, z]
paramTypes.entity: a selector expression giving one entity (self, other, @name, nearest('foe', 10))
paramTypes.entities: a selector expression giving one entity or a set (all('foe', 6)); the action runs on each member with `it` bound
paramTypes.template: a template id: a pack unit, a pack entity, or "vanilla:<id>"; "=expr" for an expression ("=self.template")
paramTypes.filter: a filter string ("foe and Building and not Wall")
paramTypes.status: a status id from the pack's statuses
paramTypes.var: a variable name (declared in vars; "$name" or target "level" for a level variable)
paramTypes.signal: a signal name (a built-in input or your own)
paramTypes.label: a label name (without #)
paramTypes.targeting: a targeting list: filter strings or { "filter", "range", "prefer", "score" } (a score picks the highest-scoring match)
paramTypes.movement: a movement block (mode, path, speed, keepDistance, kite, flee, wander, home)
paramTypes.for: seconds, or "night" / "day" (until the next dawn / dusk)
paramTypes.slot: a build slot: any expression giving a building or slot entity (@name, it, $var, a selector), or a Studio key ("slot:Tower 3", "add:<id>", "castle")
paramTypes.keep: a list of the listed options
paramTypes.color: "#rrggbb" (or "#rgb", "#rrggbbaa", a colour name like "red"); "=expr" for an expression
paramTypes.local: a plain name (letters, digits, _) for a value bound inside the action's actions

gameRules.name: victory
gameRules.description: How the level is won. lastNight: surviving the last night (vanilla). rules: only an endLevel action wins.

gameRules.name: defeat
gameRules.description: How the level is lost. castle: the castle falls (vanilla). rules: only an endLevel action (or resigning) loses.

gameRules.name: castle
gameRules.description: shown: the castle as usual. hidden: no castle (invisible, not solid, never targeted or hurt, and it can't lose the level).

gameRules.name: holdNight
gameRules.description: While true, the night doesn't end, even with no enemies left (e.g. "count('#nest') > 0"). The last night's victory waits too.

gameRules.name: endNight
gameRules.description: When it turns true at night, the night ends at once (spawning stops; survivors decides the enemies left).

gameRules.name: survivors
gameRules.description: Enemies left when endNight ends a night (waves endNight has its own). stay: they stay (and keep the next night open until killed). remove: they vanish.

gameRules.name: combat
gameRules.description: When vanilla fighting happens: units', towers' and the king's attacks, and hits on the player's side. Vanilla: "isNight". "true": by day too.

gameRules.name: build
gameRules.description: When the king can build and upgrade. Vanilla: "isDay". "true": at night too.

gameRules.name: dayLength
gameRules.description: Seconds of day before night falls by itself (0: the player calls the night).

presets.name: Timer
presets.description: Sends "{signal}" every {seconds} s ({during}). Inputs: enable, disable, toggle.

presets.name: Counter
presets.description: Counts "{input}" signals; at {target} it sends "{signal}" and starts again.

signal.description: Sent when it reaches the target.

presets.name: Relay (delay)
presets.description: Passes "{input}" on as "{signal}" after {seconds} s.

presets.name: Gate (AND)
presets.description: Sends "{signal}" once it has heard each of "{a}" and "{b}" (then resets).

presets.name: Toggle
presets.description: Each "{input}" flips it, sending "{on}" or "{off}".

presets.name: Random router
presets.description: Passes "{input}" on as "{a}" or "{b}" at random ({chanceA} for the first).

presets.name: Spawner
presets.description: On "{input}", spawns {count} {unit} here.

presets.name: Lever
presets.description: The king pulls it ({when}) to send "{signal}".

prompt.description: Shown when the king is near.

presets.name: Pressure plate
presets.description: Sends "{pressed}" when a {watch} steps on it and "{released}" when it's empty.

presets.name: Door
presets.description: A solid door. Signals "open" and "closed" swing it (poses).

angle.description: How far it swings open, degrees.

presets.name: Moving wall
presets.description: A solid wall that moves along a path ({mode}) at {speed} m/s. Inputs: start, stop, reverse.

presets.name: Sign
presets.description: Shows "{text}" when the king comes near.

presets.name: Gold pickup
presets.description: The king collects it for {amount} gold.

presets.name: HUD counter
presets.description: Each "{input}" adds 1 to the level variable ${var}; at {target} it sends "{signal}".

var.description: A level variable (declare it in logic.vars).

presets.name: Split on death
presets.description: Splits into {count} copies, {depth} times.

shrink.description: Size of each generation relative to the last.

presets.name: Spawn on death
presets.description: When it dies, {count} {unit} appear where it fell.

presets.name: Aura
presets.description: Every second, gives {status} to {who} within {range} m.

presets.name: Explode when near
presets.description: When a {filter} is within {trigger} m, it explodes for {damage} damage in {radius} m.

presets.name: Multiply
presets.description: Every {seconds} s at night it makes a copy of itself, up to {max} alive.

presets.name: Regenerate
presets.description: Heals {amount} hp every {seconds} s.

presets.name: Blink away
presets.description: Below {pct} health, once, it teleports near {to} and heals {heal}.
